description: List the templates on this account, with their latest version number. Start here: rendering needs a template, and this says which ones exist. A brand-new trial account starts with the starter library (invoice, quote, receipt, og-card, certificate and more) already loaded. Each template says where it came from in `origin`: `library` (a starter), `import` (made from the person's own document by import_document) or `own` (made with create_template). Free.
name: list_templates
title: List templates
